Wait for all child sessions, apply the critic's concrete finding through an implementation or remediation step, and run verification again afterward. Do not claim a critique loop ran unless the task tool returns distinct child session IDs and the critic produces a concrete finding. If the task tool is unavailable, stop and report the blocker instead of silently doing the work in one agent.
